title: Starship flight 15 powers to orbit—setting up a possible catch on Saturday
summary: One way or another, the company will get some more data on Saturday.
llm_summary: SpaceX’s Starship completed its 15th test flight, successfully reaching orbit and then re‑entering the atmosphere. The flight gathered a fresh batch of performance data, and SpaceX plans to analyze those results and potentially conduct a “catch” maneuver
